issue_context.title: [networkd] Add support for setting l3mdev
issue_context.body:
### Component

systemd-networkd

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe

I would like to use `systemd-networkd` to manage routing policy rules such as the following:
```
# ip rule
...
1000:	from all lookup [l3mdev-table]
1001:	from all lookup [l3mdev-table] prohibit
...
```

### Describe the solution you'd like

I would like to specify this in `[RoutingPolicyRule]`. For example:
```
[RoutingPolicyRule]
From=0.0.0.0/0
L3mdev=true
Priority=1000

[RoutingPolicyRule]
From=0.0.0.0/0
L3mdev=true
Type=prohibit
Priority=1001
```

### Describe alternatives you've considered

Without this, I may have to resort to bash scripts in `/etc/networkd-dispatcher`.

### The systemd version you checked that didn't have the feature you are asking for

253

that is a weird encoding, for something that apparently is just a boolean. I'd really just store that as a boolean in our structure though, and generate the format it needs from that when we put together the message
